name: Shared Mods
description: Mods for the character kits, found on the battlefield: a kill of yours can drop one (heavies more often, and rarer ones). A rare mod is kept as soon as it drops; a common or uncommon one is carried and kept only if the mission ends well (lost if it fails or is left). A copy found again ranks it up (rank 5 at most). Fit them on the kits' options screen (F9), SHARED MODS tab: four slots for each kit and a capacity. First mods: Cooldown (her skills' cooldowns), Resistance (damage she takes), Duration (her skills' durations), Skill Damage. Needs a character kit with the options screen. Solo or host. Settings in shared-mods.ini.
